summary: Adds src/afaw_web/ to mutation_critical_paths and sets mutation_min_score to 60 in state/config.json, a human-only file. The minimum comes from the first measurement of mutmut 3.8.0 on the CI runner (docs/submission/mutation-tools-measurement.md): app.py 62.2 percent (28 of 45 mutants), search.py 78.0 percent (46 of 59); 60 is the weakest score rounded down with a margin of 2.2 points. The minimum is one value for every required file, so it also lowers the bar for src/back/domain/ and src/back/security/ from 80 to 60; those folders do not exist in this repository today. The human reviews this change. It must be merged after task_046 and task_047: with the path set and no job running mutmut, every change to src/afaw_web would fail for lack of results. The gate has not yet run on a real merge request. After !16 and !17 (which change app.py) merge, re-measure and consider raising the minimum.
